articles.title: Attackers Target Rejetto HFS Flaw That Enables Admin Session Forgery and RCE
articles.executive_summary: Attackers are actively exploiting a critical vulnerability in Rejetto HTTP File Server (HFS) that enables admin session forgery and remote code execution. This flaw allows unauthorized access and can lead to severe operational risks.
articles.technical_breakdown: The vulnerability stems from a weak pseudo-random number generator (PRNG) that generates a predictable key, enabling attackers to forge admin sessions and execute remote code.
actionable_mitigations: Apply the latest patch for Rejetto HFS to address the vulnerability
Implement network containment or firewall rules to block unauthorized access
Monitor logs for suspicious activity and implement detection indicators
articles.telegram_snippet: Rejetto HFS vulnerability (CVE-2026-61500) under active exploitation; apply latest patch and monitor logs for unauthorized access.

articles.title: New NetScaler Zero-Day Exploited in Targeted Attacks Can Knock SAML Deployments Offline

articles.technical_breakdown: Analysis of incident reported by The Hacker News. The threat involves attack vectors targeting Citrix. Further technical telemetry is developing.

Verify all endpoint detection (EDR) agents are updated with latest behavioral signatures.
Audit exposed external assets and apply vendor security patches immediately.

articles.title: Alleged ShinyHunters Leader Arrested in Jordan
articles.executive_summary: The alleged leader of ShinyHunters, a notorious extortion group, has been arrested in Jordan. The suspect is cooperating with the FBI to identify and locate other group members.
articles.technical_breakdown: The arrest is believed to be a result of international cooperation between law enforcement agencies. The suspect's cooperation with the FBI is expected to disrupt the group's operations.

articles.title: Trump Names National Intelligence Director Jay Clayton to Lead a New Federal AI Task Force
articles.executive_summary: US President Trump has established a new federal AI task force, led by National Intelligence Director Jay Clayton, following a meeting with AI executives at the White House. The task force aims to develop AI policies and guidelines for the US government.
articles.technical_breakdown: The announcement of the task force is a result of Trump's meeting with AI executives, where they discussed the development and use of AI technologies in the US. The task force will focus on creating guidelines and policies for the use of AI in government agencies.
articles.telegram_snippet: US President Trump has established a new federal AI task force, led by National Intelligence Director Jay Clayton, to develop AI policies and guidelines for the US government.

articles.title: Anthropic asks Claude users to share voice data for AI model training
articles.executive_summary: Anthropic is asking users to voluntarily share their voice conversations to improve its AI models, raising concerns about data collection and usage. This request does not appear to be a malicious data breach, but rather a request for user consent.
articles.technical_breakdown: Anthropic is collecting voice data from users to train and improve its AI models, which may raise concerns about data ownership and control. The data collection is voluntary, but users should be aware of how their data will be used.
actionable_mitigations: Review Anthropic's data usage policies
Understand the benefits and risks of sharing voice data
articles.telegram_snippet: Anthropic asks Claude users to share voice data for AI model training, raising concerns about data collection and usage.
